name: rubicon-seven
description: Rubicon Seven — an autonomous solo-TTRPG dungeon master engine for Vaults of Vaarn. Bundles the MCP engine (~50 tools), seven skills (/vaarn-start onboarding, session lifecycle, the /menu table menu, location generation), the DM output style, narrative-quality hooks, a companion terminal dashboard, and the Vaarn rules data (from Vaults of Vaarn by Leo Hunt, CC BY 4.0). Run /vaarn-start once: it builds the Python environment and wires your campaign (cross-platform, including native Windows — no bash required).
